text:
lisa: Heads-up — NVIDIA offered an early preview slot for their next-gen APU. They asked for a short NDA + a 2-week benchmark window. Can we spin this up? @devon and @henrik, can you lead perf? @chelsea please check NDA.

devon: I can take perf. Need SSH creds to a test node and the perf image. Also need to decide which models to run — propose redwood-1-7b and redwood-1-13b quantized and fp16.

henrik: Agree on models. We should run: throughput (tokens/sec), p50/p95 latency, memory footprint, KV cache hit tests, and long-context degradation (seq 2048/4096). I'll prepare the runner scripts.

chelsea: I'll review the NDA draft. Two quick asks: 1) explicit embargo clause until joint announcement, 2) a deletion/confirm clause for test artifacts and logs after the preview window. Also check export controls.

lisa: Good catches. Partner asked for weekly syncs + a feedback loop — they want structured reports each Friday. Can we commit to that cadence?

sam_pm: Suggest we hold off on any public marketplace listing until we validate SLOs and cost numbers. We'll prepare a compatibility note for Dedicated/Private once tests are green.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace onboarding checklist updated — https://intranet/redwood/marketplace/checklist :spiral_calendar:

raj_nvidia: Thanks team — happy to move forward. We can provide an SSH jump host and a container image with `nvbench` preinstalled. We can sign the NDA tonight if legal is good. We can also supply a small synthetic dataset for cache/long-context tests.

devon: Perfect. Can you confirm the image tag? We'll run `nvbench.sh` and our `rwd-bench` harness. Example run: 
```
./rwd-bench --host ssh://preview-node --image nv-image:preview-2026-03-01 --model redwood-1-7b --seq 2048 --runs 3
```
Output we need: tokens/sec, p50/p95, GPU mem max, GPU util timeline, power draw.

henrik: Add NVML traces + `nvidia-smi dmon` for power/util, and kernel-level counters if available. We'll also capture end-to-end SLO under our batching config (min-latency vs cost-optimized).

chelsea: One legal note: no benchmarking on customer PII or private data. If they supply sample data, it must be anonymized or synthetic and explicitly permitted in the NDA. I'll add that to the draft.

lisa: Action items: 1) Chelsea to send NDA draft by EOD (chelsea) 2) Raj to enable SSH + provide image tag and dataset (raj_nvidia) 3) Devon/Henrik to run bench and produce template report (devon, henrik) 4) Weekly sync calendar invite from me for Wednesdays 10am PT (lisa) 5) Sam to freeze marketplace listing until sign-off (sam_pm). I'll update the partner tracker.

devon: Timelines — once we have access, plan: 48hr soak + 2x benchmark runs across both models. Expect initial numbers in ~5 business days.

raj_nvidia: Sounds good. We'll aim to provision the host within 24 hours of NDA. Looking forward to your feedback loop.

marketplace-bot: Checklist item added to partner tracker by lisa.

sam_pm: Also flagging this for pricing team — we may want an initial ballpark for listing (if it lands in Marketplace later).

lisa: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the NDA thread and calendar invite now. :thumbsup:
